slides.title: why does the unfinished task follow you everywhere?
slides.body:
for anyone who keeps thinking about
work they already put down.

your head keeps unfinished things
open in the background.

that is why the half-done proposal
shows up in the shower.

in one study, people who simply
wrote a *plan for an unfinished goal
stopped being distracted by it.

they hadn't finished it.
they had decided the _next step.

try this when you stop today.

for every open task, write one line:
what i do next, and when.

"draft the pricing slide, tue 9:00."

then close the laptop.
